creator: kaylawildlife
caption:
With the new update to open source AI image sequencing, I fear that soon AI will be relatively indistinguishable from real art. And no, your AI art is not real art. Its modeled by using countless images & art created by humans. It’s essentially advanced plagiarism but we won’t get into that right now. 

The main point I want to make is that we simply don’t have to use it. Its a tool, its been made available, but there is no reason as artists that we need to use it to create art. Thats what our talents & skills are for ;) 

On the consumer side of things, when we’re made aware of a brand or business using AI images & firing creatives, do not give them your money. Period. Everything is changing rapidly & tbh Im so scared of whay the future holds for artists, photographers, graphic designers, etc. One thing I know for sure though, the human soul can never be AI generated.
